slot_note: wave 7 Opportunity Sizing; seed OS12 (a solar installer splitting 2,400 retrofit batteries across four regions). The seed's split in proportion to expected sales echoes task306's allocation of battery work in lots, and a pick of one region for a retrofit round would echo task309, so the build keeps the seed's world (rooftop solar homes, 2,400 retrofit batteries, four regions) and quantity (what the batteries are worth in each region) and moves the decision to the order of four annual regional rounds, in the client domain energy-systems-utilities
niche: a state energy office's home battery programme setting the order of its four annual regional rounds of 2,400 grant-funded retrofit batteries (2027 to 2030), each region valued as the energy a battery would deliver to the monitoring panel's homes there in a year, when the network's 0.5 kW constrained-zone connection rule has the inverters of most of one region's newer estate homes holding their solar to the home's own use plus half a kilowatt
answer: Yarrandale Valley 2027, Sandhaven Coast 2028, Eastbrook Metro 2029, Tarrock Highlands 2030; the 2027 round about 5,900 MWh a year, 2,450 kWh a battery
analyst_test: A strong analyst who aligns the meter's market-time intervals with the inverters' local clock, differences the one vendor's lifetime counters, leaves out the controlled-load channel and reads every connection code correctly simulates the programme battery hour by hour against each panel home's recorded solar and use and orders the rounds Sandhaven Coast 2027, Eastbrook Metro 2028, Tarrock Highlands 2029 and Yarrandale Valley 2030, Yarrandale last at about 1,200 kWh a battery, because on the recorded flows the Yarrandale estate homes on 0.5 kW constrained-zone connections show almost no solar beyond their own use and the limit, when their inverters were holding output back and a battery would take what they held back.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the energy a home battery would deliver to the home in a year, which distributed-energy planning gets by simulating the battery against the home's interval solar and load, the solar being what the panels can produce rather than what an export-limited inverter let through; export limits, inverter curtailment and a battery's state of charge are network physics, and a noun swap into another field leaves no inverter, connection point or charge to reason about.
layer1: revenue meter intervals in market time (UTC+10 all year), stamped at the interval end, beside inverter readings on the local clock with daylight saving

one inverter vendor's feed as lifetime watt-hour counters at the local hour end with no offset (a repeated 03:00 on 6 April, none on 5 October, a restart from zero on replacement), the other in watt-hours per hour with its UTC offset
a controlled-load (off-peak hot water) register on a second meter channel
meter replacements that start a new meter serial part-way through the year
estimated and substituted meter reads carried with quality flags
panel home identifiers keyed to network meter identifiers through the panel register
connection agreement codes for the export limit, with effective dates
stakeholder_role: the energy analyst in the state energy office's home battery programme, preparing the round order the minister approves

spine.entity: one half hour of one panel home's revenue-meter reads (import, controlled load, export)
spine.source: synthetic (fictional Australian state's home energy monitoring panel)

world.org_type: a state government energy office running a home battery grant programme

driver: An added store's yield is simulated against each site's recorded output, but at sites on a low send-out limit the recorded output is only what the site's own equipment let through, held to the site's use at the time plus the limit; the store would take what the hold discards, so its yield has to be simulated on the output those sites could produce, rebuilt hour by hour from comparable unlimited sites under the same sky, which moves the group where most sites sit on the limit from last to first.
driver_concrete: The programme values each region's round by simulating its 10 kWh battery against every panel home's 2025 hourly solar and use; 28 of Yarrandale Valley's 40 panel homes are estate homes on 0.5 kW constrained-zone connections, so their inverters hold solar to the home's use plus half a kilowatt, their recorded solar barely exceeds it and their batteries look nearly idle (1,210 kWh a battery for the region), while rebuilt from the unlimited Yarrandale homes' output per kWp each hour those batteries fill on most days and Yarrandale's round delivers the most energy of the four (2,458 kWh a battery).
stump: A competent analyst simulates the programme battery against each panel home's recorded hourly solar and use and runs the rounds Sandhaven Coast 2027, Eastbrook Metro 2028, Tarrock Highlands 2029 and Yarrandale Valley 2030, Yarrandale last at about 1,200 kWh a battery; the 28 Yarrandale estate homes on 0.5 kW constrained-zone connections recorded only the solar their own use and the limit took because their inverters held the rest back, and with their output rebuilt from the unlimited Yarrandale homes' energy per kWp each hour their batteries fill on most days, so Yarrandale goes first at about 2,450 kWh a battery.

differentiation.task309: a retrofit grant round given to one of four counties on a mitigation's effect read by gust class; this draw orders four annual battery rounds on a storage simulation whose input record is throttled at the connection limit: no event set, no effect modifier, a sequence rather than a pick
differentiation.task308: capacity offers valued on shortfall hours with a unit class out together from one shared cause; this draw values home storage on the solar it would absorb, where the record understates the supply because the site's own inverter cut it to the site's use
differentiation.task136: a rooftop PV forecast where a bulk-buy mostly enrols homes about to install anyway; this draw takes the installed systems as given and recovers what their throttled inverters did not record
differentiation.task18: demand censored by supply rebuilt from a lost-volume log; this draw rebuilds a physical output cut at a limit that moves with the site's own load, from comparable sites without the limit, and the decision turns on a storage simulation on top of it
differentiation.task470: activity a sensor never records on some units, rebuilt as a count of those units times the fully counted sites' rate; this draw rebuilds a physical output each limited home's own inverter held to the home's load hour by hour, and the decision turns on a storage simulation whose daily fill depends on that hour-by-hour surplus, not on a count
differentiation.task197: a unit's response to a shared signal confounded by a scheduled trajectory known only at its endpoints; this draw has no shared signal or schedule: the record is held down by each site's own export limit and the battery's yield is simulated on the rebuilt output

notes: Architecture 1. Stump strategy other: throttled-output recovery, a record that carries a site's output only after a limit set by the site's own load at that hour (closest families estimation_fit censoring and truncation; not maturity or informative censoring). Gap population: the recorded solar is not the solar the panels produce. Gate G binding_constraint: the network's export limit binds on the recorded output (the inverter holds solar to the home's use plus the limit), and that binding limit is exactly what puts the naive order wrong: on the recorded flows the limited region comes last, while the battery's charging is not bound by an export limit at all. Generators G3 (record versus operation) and G12 (an export pinned at the limit read as no surplus rather than as a hold the record does not show). Forum: the energy minister approves the round order with the programme's 2027 to 2030 appropriation (budget_or_appropriation). Context artifact: the monitoring panel's 2025 export (monitoring_export).
